title: Repeated Payment Latency Pattern
description: The agent has experienced several previous incidents and encounters another payment API latency problem.

symptoms: API latency is increasing during high traffic

expected_behavior.memory_context: Several relevant historical incidents should be available
expected_behavior.response_style: Contextual troubleshooting based on previous incidents
expected_behavior.expected_pattern: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion during high traffic
suggested_action: Compare current connection usage with previous incidents
Check whether application concurrency has increased
Consider increasing connection pool capacity if confirmed

learning_goal: Demonstrate that the agent can use relevant historical incidents to make its investigation more contextual.
